subject: CONFIDENTIAL: Termination + Severance Packet — Irene Choi
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Confidential: proposed involuntary separation — Irene Choi

Team —

Per our 1:1 this morning, after the formal investigatory review and the leadership calibration call, I recommend we move forward with an involuntary separation for Irene Choi in Product. The issues and documentation are in the attached evidence_summary_ichoi.txt; we've had progressive coaching and three documented performance improvement conversations (timeline summarized there).

I need HR and legal to review two things before we schedule an in-person meeting: 1) draft severance language and statutory compliance (California final pay if applicable), and 2) an asset/access disablement plan we can activate immediately after the conversation.

Key constraints: keep this strictly confidential for now — only the people on this thread and counsel. I would like a severance offer that includes 6 weeks pay (pending legal) with standard release, continuation of health through the month, and a two-week transition for knowledge transfer if acceptable. Please also confirm whether we should involve exec coms or keep this at manager+HR counsel.

Attachments: evidence_summary_ichoi.txt

Thanks,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Management
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Cynthia Ross <cynthia.ross@burnslegal.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential: proposed involuntary separation — Irene Choi

Karthik —

Thanks for the summary and the attachment. I've looped in Cynthia from Burns Legal for a quick read on the language and California compliance items. Cynthia — please see the attached evidence summary and let me know whether 6 weeks + standard release is safe from a legal exposure perspective and whether we need to adjust for any WARN/COBRA considerations.

Action items I will own: draft severance_offer_ichoi_v1.pdf (using our template), confirm final pay dates, and coordinate benefits continuation. Monica, I need the asset list and proposed IT cutoff times so we can align the meeting timing.

Confidential — do not forward.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
From: Cynthia Ross <cynthia.ross@burnslegal.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Confidential: proposed involuntary separation — Irene Choi

Mina, Karthik —

Reviewed the evidence summary and the prior coaching notes. On preliminary read, 6 weeks' severance with a standard release is reasonable. A few points:

- Ensure final pay is calculated with PTO/unused vacation per CA law (I see accruals in the HRIS).
- We should avoid language that could be interpreted as an admission of wrongdoing; standard neutral release language is preferable.
- Two calendar items: provide the employee a copy of the release and allow 7 days to consider. If you want a quick separation, we can offer pay in lieu of the 7-day window but only after confirming there is no pending litigation risk.
- Suggest DocuSign for execution (I can redline the template and return by EOD).

Send me the draft and I'll circle back with redlines.

— Cynthia
Cynthia Ross
Partner, Employment & Litigation
Burns Legal LLP
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Cynthia Ross <cynthia.ross@burnslegal.com>, PayrollOps <payroll@payrollco.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Draft severance packet and proposed schedule — Irene Choi

Attached: severance_offer_ichoi_v1.pdf; termination_checklist_2026-10.xlsx

Team —

Draft attached. Highlights: 6 weeks gross pay, continuation of medical through month-end, standard release, outplacement voucher of $1,000, and reimbursement of return shipping for company equipment. PayrollOps — please confirm we can issue a one-time gross payment and the expected date if we approve today.

Monica — proposed IT schedule is inline on the checklist: disable privileged access immediately after meeting (T+0), disable general account at T+1 business day, retrieval of laptop by courier within 5 days. Please confirm you can meet that schedule.

Karthik — confirm if you want me to present the packet in the meeting or have Cynthia present the legal terms. Also confirm whether you want to offer pay in lieu of the 7-day review period (per Cynthia's note).

Confidential — HR draft.

Thanks,
Mina
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T09:58:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft severance packet and proposed schedule — Irene Choi

Mina / Karthik —

Confirmed: IT will follow the termination_checklist_2026-10.xlsx schedule. Specifics:
- T+0 (after meeting): revoke admin/remote access, change shared service credentials that Irene had access to.
- T+0.5 (30 mins after): terminate SSO session tokens and reset MFA on corporate accounts.
- T+1 business day: suspend mailbox (read-only) and disable Slack access; set vacation autoresponder pointing to product@redwood.com.
- Device retrieval: we will courier the laptop; tracking attached in checklist.

I'll also export the last seven days of access logs and add to the internal HR folder in case legal needs them (link in checklist).

Monica Patel
IT Security Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Cynthia Ross <cynthia.ross@burnslegal.com>
Cc: PayrollOps <payroll@payrollco.com>, DocuSign <no-reply@docusign.net>
Date: 2026-11-03T16:04:00-07:00
Subject: Final: Meeting scheduled + DocuSign packet — Irene Choi

All —

Final plan: in-person meeting scheduled for 2026-11-04 at 10:00 PST. Cynthia will attend remotely for any legal clarifications. I've uploaded the redlined severance to our Drive and generated the DocuSign packet: https://docusign.com/some-fake-id/ABC12345 (placeholder). PayrollOps confirmed they can issue the one-time payment on 2026-11-06 if we approve the packet by end of day 11/03.

Cynthias' redlines are included; I accepted neutral release language and added the 7-day review period but also included the option to pay in lieu if exec approves immediate separation. Karthik — please confirm whether you want us to offer pay-in-lieu (we need the greenlight to present that tomorrow).

Attachments: severance_offer_ichoi_v1.pdf (redlined), termination_checklist_2026-10.xlsx

Confidential and privileged.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
